metadata.name: session_manager
metadata.description: Session Manager Program for MagicBlock Ephemeral Rollup integration

instructions.name: abandon_session
docs: Abandons a session at any time (user-initiated).
Requires the main wallet signature.
Used when player wants to quit a session early.
Closes all session-related accounts to allow starting a new session on the same level.

instructions.name: close_orphaned_accounts
docs: Close orphaned child accounts after force_close_session already freed the session PDA.
Session PDA no longer exists, so we validate via game_state (which stores session_signer
and player). Only closes accounts that are on base layer (owned by their programs).
Call order: map_pois → map_enemies → game_state (game_state last since others depend on it).

accounts.name: game_state
docs: GameState is the auth source — stores session_signer and player.
May be delegated (skipped if so).

accounts.name: map_enemies
docs: Map enemies account — may be delegated.

accounts.name: map_pois
docs: Map POIs account — may be delegated.

accounts.name: player
docs: Player wallet receives rent refunds.

accounts.name: session_signer
docs: Session key signer — validated by child program CPIs via game_state.session_signer.

instructions.name: close_session_only
docs: Emergency fallback: settle run result (if needed) and close only the game_session account.
This allows users to recover from ER child-account undelegation failures and start new runs.
Child runtime accounts may remain delegated/stuck and must be cleaned up separately.

accounts.name: game_state
docs: Game state account can still be delegated; validated in handler.

accounts.name: player_profile
docs: Player profile for recording run result (if not settled yet)

instructions.name: commit_session
docs: Commits the current game state from the ephemeral rollup.
This must be sent to the ephemeral rollup connection.

instructions.name: delegate_game_state
docs: Delegates gameplay-state account to the MagicBlock delegation program.

instructions.name: delegate_generated_map
docs: Delegates generated-map account to the MagicBlock delegation program.

instructions.name: delegate_inventory
docs: Delegates inventory account to the MagicBlock delegation program.

instructions.name: delegate_map_enemies
docs: Delegates map-enemies account to the MagicBlock delegation program.

instructions.name: delegate_map_pois
docs: Delegates map-pois account to the MagicBlock delegation program.

instructions.name: delegate_poi_vrf_state
docs: Delegates PoiVrfState account to the MagicBlock delegation program.
Only needed for PvP sessions that use VRF for POI offers.

instructions.name: delegate_session
docs: Marks the session delegated and delegates the session account itself.

instructions.name: end_session
docs: Ends the session after death or level completion.
Only callable by session key signer when player is dead OR has completed the level.
Also closes the player's inventory via CPI to ensure fresh inventory for next session.
This is designed to be called automatically by the frontend after combat,
signed only by the session key signer (no user interaction required).

instructions.name: force_close_session
docs: Tolerant session close: settles result (defeat if unreadable) and closes whichever
child accounts are on base layer. Delegated/missing children are skipped.
This prevents the permanent soft-lock where close_session_only leaves orphaned
child accounts that block start_session (which uses `init`, not `init_if_needed`).

instructions.name: start_duel_session
docs: Starts a duel session with fixed mid difficulty.
This path is intentionally decoupled from campaign unlock progression:
- Uses a fixed campaign level (DUEL_CAMPAIGN_LEVEL) for balance.
- Derives duel seed on-chain.
- Does not consume campaign runs.

accounts.name: map_vrf_state
docs: Optional MapVrfState for VRF-derived map/POI seeds.
When provided, seeds are derived from VRF randomness instead of derive_pvp_seed.

instructions.name: start_gauntlet_session
docs: Starts a gauntlet session using the same fixed difficulty profile as Duels.

accounts.name: map_vrf_state
docs: Optional MapVrfState for VRF-derived map/POI seeds.

instructions.name: start_session
docs: Starts a new game session with all dependencies initialized (Game State, Inventory, etc.).
Validates:
- Player has available runs > 0
- Campaign level is within player's unlocked range (1 to highest_level_unlocked)
- No existing session for this (player, level) pair
Actions:
- Creates session with snapshot of player's active_item_pool
- Generates the map via CPI to map-generator
- Initializes game state via CPI to gameplay-state
- Initializes inventory via CPI to player-inventory
- Emits SessionStarted event

accounts.name: player_profile
docs: Player profile for validation and run consumption (from player-profile program)

accounts.name: session_signer
docs: Session key signer that will own all session-specific accounts (inventory, etc.)
Must be a signer so it can be set as the inventory owner for gameplay transactions.

accounts.name: map_config
docs: Map configuration for map generation

instructions.name: undelegate_session
docs: Commits and undelegates the session account from the ephemeral rollup.
This must be sent to the ephemeral rollup connection.

types.name: GameSession
docs: Represents an active game session for a player.
Campaign PDA seeds: [b"session", player.key(), &[campaign_level]]
Duel/Gauntlet use dedicated prefixes to avoid collisions with campaign levels.

types.name: PlayerProfile
docs: PlayerProfile account - mirrors the structure from player-profile program.
IMPORTANT: The account name MUST be "PlayerProfile" (not PlayerProfileAccount)
to generate the correct Anchor discriminator (sha256("account:PlayerProfile")[..8]).
We use AnchorDeserialize manually since we can't use #[account] with a custom owner.
